judged_text: Team destination calendars are collected only under isTeamEventType && schedulingType === 'COLLECTIVE', which excludes dynamic collective bookings (multiple users via dynamicUserList carry no schedulingType), and the removed comment explicitly listed 'dynamic collective events' as part of the requirement. Dynamic group bookings (user1+user2) still create the calendar event only for the first user; that half of the requirement is silently dropped by this PR.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, additional destination calendars are only collected in `teamMemberPromises` when `isTeamEventType && eventType.schedulingType === "COLLECTIVE"` (push into `teamDestinationCalendars`), and then only appended when the same condition holds (`if (isTeamEventType && eventType.schedulingType === "COLLECTIVE") evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`). Since `isTeamEventType` is derived solely from `eventType.schedulingType` (not from `users.length`/`dynamicUserList`), any multi-user booking scenario that doesn’t have `eventType.schedulingType === "COLLECTIVE"` will still only use the organizer/eventType destination calendar (first entry). However, the finding’s specific claim that dynamic collective bookings have “no schedulingType” is not verifiable from the diff; `schedulingType` is read from `eventType` and also written onto `evt` (`schedulingType: eventType.schedulingType`). This looks more like a potentially incomplete requirement/edge-case handling than a demonstrable regression/defect strictly proven by the diff.
